record.question: 'A', a private organization hires an employee at less than a minimum wage. By this action 'A':
options: Violates the rights of the employee under Article 23 of the Constitution
Does not violate the rights of the employee under Article 23 of the Constitution
Does not violate the rights of the employee under Article 23 of the Constitution since Article 23 only applies against the State
Does not violate Article 23 of the Constitution as it is not forced labour
